market_mistake: The market still prices raw frontier-model IP as the centre of AI value capture. If the frontier-to-open catch-up window holds at ~3-6 months or compresses further, frontier-grade capability becomes an abundant input rather than a scarce asset: model IP commoditizes, and durable value capture migrates to the model-agnostic layers — ABOVE the model (applications with workflow, user, data and regulatory moats), BELOW it (hyperscaler compute, distribution and data gravity), and BESIDE it (silicon vendors whose software/developer-ecosystem bundle captures AI economics whichever model wins). The mistake is a supply-side one: pricing the model layer as scarce while open-source proliferation makes it abundant — scarcity is moving to the layers that own the workflow, the distribution and the ecosystem.
null_thesis: The catch-up window WIDENS again — a capability step-change open weights cannot replicate, or compute/regulatory barriers that re-open the gap. Frontier-model IP retains pricing power as the scarce asset, the model-agnostic layers capture no incremental share of AI economics, and neither the app layer, the hyperscalers, nor the silicon-ecosystem vendors re-rate on this driver.
